reviews_1_to_3_star.title: Good, but missing something...
reviews_1_to_3_star.text:
First of all, a huge thank you to the developer for the time and effort put into making the app. I know it's a labor of love, so I hope my criticism doesn't come across as whining or a sense of entitlement... that is not my intention.

I have owned all of the apps that use BGG as its base (?) and this one is certainly the prettiest. (And, as far as I can tell, the only one still being supported). I have no clue why -- but with this app it seems that only a select few of the titles stay in-app when trying to read the forums for any particular game. I would say that maybe 1 out of 10 of the games I browse, and try to read the forums for stay in the app... the others open up the forums page on BGG. So, while I can still kind of access the info I am looking for, it is usually very frustrating to navigate the forums by the browser on this app on my phone. So much so that I find myself using the outdated, no-longer-supported and older apps more frequently  than this one.

I am only writing this with the hopes that this issue may be resolved. I don't know why this issue happens, or why it doesn't happen with ALL of the games (just most), but that is the one thing that keeps me from using it on a daily basis. I have waited this long to write about this issue because I kept wondering if I was doing something wrong, or if the next update would resolve this issue. But it has been a very long time and this issue persists.

This is certainly the best app out there for quickly browsing the current BGG hotness lists and Top games, or even my own collection -- but if you like to dive into forums for rules clarifications, reviews, etc. I would recommend browsing the BGG site directly through a web browsing app on your phone, rather than using this app as a resource. 

I will revise this review and give this app a well-deserved full 5 stars if/when this issue is resolved. 

And, again, thank you to the developer for giving us the most attractive app of this kind at this moment! It really is very nicely designed.

reviews_1_to_3_star.title: Great start
reviews_1_to_3_star.text:
I love the potential for this app, but I’m having a few issues. One: I can’t figure out how to ADD a friend, the app just tells me I have none, which is sad and untrue. Also when I log a game I am unable to save a typed score - I have to spin the little number dial thing to get high scores to save. 

I really appreciate that it shows all expansions, including promo cards, for every game so I know what I’m missing! And, of course, that it links to my BGG profile. The search function works very well and shows all related items and editions. 

It does not deal with typos well for some reason. It highlights a word my phone doesn’t know, but doesn’t allow me to correct it like my phone usually does, so I have to use a workaround to search for games. 

One thing that would be nice is to be able categorize and search my owned games by mechanisms.

Then after the opponent got three pieces left and could go anywhere it wanted to, I kept making mills but wasn't allowed to remove the opponent's pieces.  So I made multiple mills and the opponent kept capturing my pieces, but I still couldn't remove any of the opponent's pieces.  Reread the rules to see if I missed something.  Couldn't figure out why the hard version was different than the medium version when it came to the rules of the game.

Also, the medium difficulty for all the other games were really hard.  Can't imagine how difficult hard is.  Haven't played on easy yet.

Otherwise, it's been nice to have all these board games at my fingertips.  Much better than the other free board game app, scripty font and all.
